user.title: Connect to Degiro
user.description: This uses Degiro's unofficial web API with read-only requests. Your credentials are stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage.

data_description.totp_secret_key: The base32 secret shown when you set up your authenticator app. Required if two-factor authentication is enabled. SMS-only 2FA is not supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Degiro
reauth_confirm.description: Degiro rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password (and 2FA secret).

error.invalid_auth: Degiro rejected the username, password or 2FA secret.
error.totp_required: Two-factor authentication is enabled on this account. Enter the 2FA secret (TOTP).
error.app_approval: Open the Degiro app and approve the login attempt, then submit again.
error.captcha_required: Degiro requires a captcha. Log in once in your browser, solve it, then try again.
error.maintenance: Degiro is in scheduled maintenance. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Degiro account is already configured.

init.title: Degiro Portfolio options
init.description: Prices are fetched every interval. Degiro itself is only contacted about once a day, or when you press "Refresh from Degiro".

data_description.ticker_overrides: One per line, as ISIN=TICKER, for example IE00BK5BQT80=VWCE.DE. Use this when the automatically chosen Yahoo listing is wrong. Lines starting with # are ignored.

error.invalid_overrides: Each line must look like ISIN=TICKER, for example IE00BK5BQT80=VWCE.DE.
